edits.old: | BR8 | The case statuses ASSET_ON_BOOKS, RENTAL_RUNNING and HANDED_TO_DISPOSAL are rwb-case's: this contract declares no status value and no case event | ASM-4388; GAP-2680 |
edits.new: | BR8 | The case statuses ASSET_ON_BOOKS, RENTAL_RUNNING and HANDED_TO_DISPOSAL are rwb-case's: this contract declares no status value and no case event; the case status and the case task are moved by the parent CaseWorkflow | ASM-4388; GAP-2680 |

edits.old: | BR9 | A published version is never edited: a backward-compatible change keeps major version 1, a breaking change raises major version 2 with a new `ce_type`, and every consumer pins a version | Template and Rules §R7.2; Architecture v5 slides 42 and 43 notes |
